anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in close physical combat; one appears to strike or grapple the other in a dimly lit alleyway.

A large group of individuals (≥6) is gathered in a chaotic, aggressive formation; some hold objects resembling weapons, and collective motion suggests violent unrest rather than a static confrontation.

A person is on the ground while multiple others surround and appear to assault them; one individual is crouched over the prone figure in a manner consistent with striking or subduing a helpless victim.
A large group of individuals converges violently in a confined space; some are armed, others are being subdued or attacked, indicating collective violent unrest.

Two individuals are engaged in close physical combat, with one person on top of the other in a struggle; visible grappling and forceful movement suggest mutual physical combat.
A person is being physically subdued or attacked by another individual in a dim, smoky room; the victim appears prone and helpless while the attacker looms over them.

A second muzzle flash occurs in near-total darkness, with a silhouette of a weapon and hand visible; consistent with another gunshot.
A second bright flash and smoke plume appear near the ceiling/light fixture, suggesting a secondary electrical failure or explosion following the first event.
